source.upstream: Maton Outlook Email and Calendar skill

description: A real Microsoft Outlook Email and Calendar API skill for managed-OAuth access to emails, folders, contacts, calendar events, and attachments via the Microsoft Graph API.
authorization_notes: Mail send is irreversible; confirm recipient list, subject, body, and any attachments with explicit user approval before sending.
Reply and forward operations use existing thread context; verify the original message content and confirm the reply/forward recipients with the user.
Calendar event creation sends invitations to attendees; confirm event details, time, and attendee list before creating.
Message move, delete and mark-as-read operations modify mailbox state; confirm the target messages and operation with the user.
